8 — went to a school with a strict dress code?
9 — wanted to leave school as soon as he/she could?
10 — did not have friends at school?

r1.exp: 1=E (Edward: 'travelling on Saturdays to play football for the school'). 2=C (Callum: 'my parents never said it, I'm sure they felt I could have done better'). 3=D (Daisy: 'couldn't stand the food and took sandwiches to school'). 4=A (Alexander: 'My French teacher called me stupid, so I couldn't even listen to the language after that'). 5=F (Freya: 'Crazy as it was, I didn't want it to end'). 6=B (Bethany: 'I knew that my parents would be very disappointed...so I often cheated in tests'). 7=C (Callum: 'I lived for the breaks... best was the lunch break'). 8=F (Freya: 'all sorts of restrictions on how we could behave and what we should wear'). 9=D (Daisy: 'wasn't expected to stay on at school after the minimum school-leaving age'). 10=E (Edward: 'none of my classmates lived near me, and I had no one to play with'). 11=B (Bethany: 'I wish I could have that time again'). 12=D (Daisy: 'My English teacher for some reason treated me better than the others').

r13.exp: 'My parents just DIDN'T SEE LEARNING AS A PRIORITY' = roditelji nisu bili zainteresirani = D.

r14.exp: 'I wasn't ALL THAT BOTHERED' = nije ga previše briga = B (He did not care).

r15.exp: 'Fell in with a different crowd WHO THOUGHT SWIMMING WAS DULL AND UNCOOL' = popustio pritisku vršnjaka = D (peer pressure).

r16.exp: 'The CONSTANT PLEADING OF MY FIANCÉE forced me to give in' = pritisak od zaručnice = B.

r17.exp: 'I HADN'T EXPECTED that it wouldn't be part of the physical education curriculum' = iznenadilo ga da nema plivanja u školi = A.

r18.exp: 'My only doubt is the possible impact on his ACADEMIC PROGRESS... his MARKS are borderline' = brine se za školske ocjene = C.

r19.exp: 'Teachers not specialists, insufficient training. (19)___. And this year, Gove indicated removal.' → D: Meanwhile, the handful of enthusiastic citizenship teachers found their subject given little status. Nadovezuje se na probleme s nastavnicima.

r20.exp: 'If I didn't do it, can't be important. (20)___. Voter turnout is low...' → G: Yet too many British adults struggle to understand this country's politics. Dokaz da nedostatak obrazovanja stvara politički nepismenene građane.

r21.exp: 'Democracies need active citizens... (21)___. They do not develop unaided. They have to be learnt.' → B: The removal of citizenship education takes away one of the few ways the state can encourage such behaviour.

r22.exp: 'Government talking of society where everybody improves communities. (22)___. These are hardly joke areas.' → F: These are strong arguments against abandoning citizenship education, which teaches about democracy, politics, education and the law.

r23.exp: 'Can never be sufficient... (23)___. Primary schools should teach the basics.' → A: However, citizenship education should not be limited to schools. Treba biti u primarnom obrazovanju, ne samo u sekundarnom.

r24.exp: 'Grow up with a sense of community. (24)___. Thus they would make a more active citizenry.' → C: In this way, they are more likely to make a positive contribution to their communities and in society at large.

r25.exp: 'Continue to AFFECT the ozone layer' — 'affect' (glagol) = utjecati na. 'Effect' je imenica.

r26.exp: 'Its effectiveness is DETERIORATING' — 'deteriorate' = pogoršavati se, slabiti (o kvaliteti/učinkovitosti).

r27.exp: 'UV rays PENETRATE this protective layer' — 'penetrate' ne treba prijedlog uz objekt: penetrate + objekt (proći kroz).

r28.exp: 'A huge rise HAS BEEN reported recently' — present perfect passive za nedavni razvoj (recently → present perfect).

r29.exp: 'Could be reversed if people WERE sensible enough' — uvjetna rečenica 2. tipa (nerealni uvjet): if + past simple → could.

r30.exp: 'How hot IT IS' — neizravno pitanje: red riječi kao u izjavnoj rečenici (subject + verb).

r31.exp: 'Spread yourself OUT on the sand' — frazalni glagol: spread out = prostrijeti se (na pijesku).

r32.exp: 'Wear SOME protection' — 'some' uz nebrojive imenice (protection je nebrojivy).

r33.exp: 'Earlier than he usually DID' — elipsa: 'woke up' je izostavljen jer je isti glagol, zamjenjuje se s 'did'.

r34.exp: 'TO his surprise' — fiksni izraz: to his/her/my surprise = na (njegovo) iznenađenje.

r35.exp: 'The first person TO suggest' — infinitiv uz superlativnu/ordinalnu konstrukciju: the first/last/only + to + infinitive.

r36.exp: 'To MAKE better use of daylight' — fiksna kolokacija: make use of / make better use of = iskoristiti.

r37.exp: 'Everybody OUGHT to get up earlier' — modalni glagol 'ought to' = trebalo bi. 'Needed to' / 'had to' su također prihvatljivi.

r38.exp: 'Not long ENOUGH for outdoor recreation' — 'enough' dolazi iza pridjeva: adj + enough.

r39.exp: 'Two years after World War I BROKE out' — frazalni glagol: break out = izbiti (o ratu, požaru).

r40.exp: 'So NEVER saw his idea put into effect' — 'never' za negaciju bez 'not': he never saw it.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA grupni rad: dijeljenje ideja, podrška, raznolikost vještina, motivacija. ZA individualni rad: vlastiti tempo, fokus, nema konflikata, osobna odgovornost. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, 200–250 riječi.
